rules: A registry or lexical match alone does not satisfy the reuse gate.

For a mathematical calculus or theorem interface, applying its exact declared input/output law and hard boundary to the current task counts as REUSE_APPLIED even when no software execution is required.

When a matching executable source method is required for the claimed computation/certificate and the current environment can execute it, use the existing implementation rather than silently reimplementing it and record REUSE_EXECUTED.

When executable reuse is materially required but unavailable in the current environment, record REUSE_IDENTIFIED_EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE; do not claim that the executable tool was run and do not treat unavailability as a capability gap in the mathematics/tool family.
COMPOSE_APPLIED requires identifying the concrete existing tools/methods being composed and preserving each hard boundary.
EXTEND_EXISTING_TOOL requires a capability absent from the existing interface while preserving ownership of the existing family.
CAPABILITY_GAP_CONFIRMED requires an exact missing input/output capability, not merely a naming/package/domain difference.
Before constructing a new general-purpose mechanism, every relevant coverage match must have one explicit reuse-resolution state.

TASK_RESEARCH.when: after the exact task semantics and first necessary dependency are understood, before constructing a new general-purpose mechanism or helper calculus, unless the exact taskbook declares an active discovery-information firewall that postpones current-tool visibility until a named freeze point
TASK_RESEARCH.action: query the current toolbox registry, method inventory and executable-source search surface; resolve every relevant match through reuse_resolution; apply or execute the narrowest adequate existing tool when available, or record the exact missing capability

TASK_RESEARCH_DISCOVERY_FIREWALL.action_before_freeze: obey the exact task-local source whitelist/information firewall; do not expose current tool names or catalogs merely to enforce reuse
TASK_RESEARCH_DISCOVERY_FIREWALL.action_after_freeze: run the same toolbox/method dedup lookup and reuse-resolution gate before claiming method novelty or opening a tool continuation; preserve the frozen result even when it collides with an existing tool
TASK_RESEARCH_DISCOVERY_FIREWALL.scope_rule: this exception exists only when the controlling taskbook explicitly declares a discovery firewall and freeze point; ordinary TASK_RESEARCH cannot self-declare blindness to skip reuse

RESEARCH_DRIVER.when: during intake/routing of a research return and before opening any task whose novelty is a new method/tool/mechanism
RESEARCH_DRIVER.action: deduplicate against existing tool families, subtools, domain facades and executable methods; require an explicit reuse-resolution state and route to reuse/composition/extension unless a capability gap is explicit

FOUNDATION_STEWARD.when: before accepting a shared method/tool surface or a Foundation-facing decomposition that appears to introduce reusable machinery
FOUNDATION_STEWARD.action: check whether the mechanism already exists, require an explicit reuse-resolution state, and preserve theorem/tool ownership and semantic layer

FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY_PHASE_A.action: computation/formalization may test a question that independently arose from the primitive substrate, but current tool families/method inventories may not choose the first question or candidate

FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY_PHASE_B.when: immediately after the candidate/no-go packet is frozen and before claiming method novelty, uniqueness or a new reusable mechanism
FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY_PHASE_B.action: open the toolbox/method surfaces for falsification, deduplication, reuse and integration, then resolve every relevant match through reuse_resolution

lookup_layers.rule: AST/docstring/public-function discovery through tools/enterprise_toolbox.py; absence from curated inventories is not evidence that no reusable method exists

required_questions: Which current tool families were checked?
Which concrete callable methods or recent harvested methods were checked?
What reuse-resolution state was assigned to each relevant match?
How was the existing tool applied/executed, or why was execution unavailable?
Why is reuse or composition insufficient at the required semantic strength?
Is the residue an extension of an existing tool or a genuinely new family?
What exact input/output capability is missing?
new_mechanism_gate.rule: If the gap is only naming, packaging, a special case, a different application domain, or inability to execute an otherwise adequate existing implementation in the current chat environment, do not create a new tool family. Register an alias/specialization/domain facade, reuse the mathematical interface, or record execution unavailability as appropriate.

required_for: route closure with a reusable procedure/certificate/operator
post_return_harvest.required_action: update the registry/inventory when reuse value or routing changes; otherwise persist the no-tool classification in the Driver/Steward review
